mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sys_member m JOIN auth_user u ON u.id::text = m.user_id WHERE m.role_code = 'system_admin' AND m.deleted = FALSE AND u.enabled = TRUE AND u.deleted = FALSE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_member (workspace_id, user_id, role_code, source, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{roleCode}, 'manual', now(), now(), 'system', 'system', FALSE) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, user_id, role_code) DO UPDATE SET deleted = FALSE, update_at = now()

INSERT INTO sys_member (workspace_id, user_id, role_code, source, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{source}, now(), now(), 'system', 'system', FALSE) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, user_id, role_code) DO UPDATE SET deleted = FALSE, source = EXCLUDED.source, update_at = now(), update_by = 'system'
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id AS workspaceId, user_id AS userId, role_code AS roleCode, source AS source, deleted AS deleted FROM sys_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT workspace_id AS workspaceId, user_id AS userId, role_code AS roleCode, source AS source, deleted AS deleted FROM sys_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source = #{source} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sys_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE )

SELECT workspace_id AS workspaceId, user_id AS userId, role_code AS roleCode, source AS source, deleted AS deleted FROM sys_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted = FALSE AND role_code <> 'system_admin' ORDER BY user_id, role_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted = FALSE AND role_code <> 'system_admin'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND role_code = 'workspace_admin' AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_member SET deleted = TRUE, update_at = now() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = FALSE
